pageIntro.title: Our Partners
pageIntro.subtitle: A collaborative initiative bringing together European and African expertise
pageIntro.description: AI4Startups is made possible through the collaboration of funders, implementing organizations, and technical partners committed to building Africa's AI ecosystem. Together, we're supporting startups, developing open-source models, and fostering innovation across the continent.

funders.sectionDescription: AI4Startups is funded under the EU's Global Gateway initiative, part of Team Europe's commitment to digital transformation in Africa.

euAttribution.disclaimer: This website was created and maintained with the financial support of the European Union. Its contents are the sole responsibility of Digital Africa and do not necessarily reflect the views of the European Union.

teamEurope.title: Team Europe
teamEurope.description: Team Europe brings together the EU, its Member States, and European financial institutions to maximize impact through coordinated action.

implementingPartners.sectionDescription: These organizations are responsible for designing, managing, and executing the AI4Startups program across Africa.

partners.name: Digital Africa
partners.role: Main implementer (AI4Startups / AI4SU): programme design, coordination, partner management, content + platform delivery
partners.shortDescription: Lead implementer of AI4SU within Data Governance in Africa. Coordinates legal/data-sharing workstream, hackathons (online + event), ecosystem analysis, and dissemination of open-source models & resources.
partners.fullDescription: Lead implementer of AI4SU within Data Governance in Africa. Coordinates legal/data-sharing workstream, hackathons (online + event), ecosystem analysis, and dissemination of open-source models & resources.
contributions: Main implementer (AI4Startups / AI4SU): programme design, coordination, partner management, content + platform delivery

partners.name: Expertise France

contributions: Co-implementation / donor-side partner (Data Governance in Africa)

serviceProviders.sectionDescription: Specialized partners delivering technical expertise, research, and operational support.

providers.name: Daniel Kingston Andrew
providers.description: Web design support for the AI4SU platform (UI/UX and website implementation support).

providers.name: Blossom Academy
providers.description: Local delivery partner for Ghana in-person hackathons: mobilisation, venue/logistics, mentors/jury coordination, event execution.

providers.name: Impact Hub Nairobi
providers.description: Local delivery partner for Kenya in-person hackathons: mobilisation, venue/logistics, mentors/jury coordination, event execution.

providers.name: Women Who Build Africa (WWBA)
providers.description: Women founders support: community mobilisation, sessions/events, and pipeline support for women-led startups within AI4SU.

providers.name: Cage Patrick & Company Advocates
providers.description: Provided legal support and templates (incl. data sharing agreement) to enable trusted startup data sharing during AI4SU.
services: Legal support / data sharing agreement template (AI4SU)

providers.name: Abze
providers.description: Co-delivered women founders support activities and events (with WWBA) for AI4SU.

providers.name: data354
providers.description: Partner for the 'Data without Borders' regulatory workshop/event and production of the associated policy brief.

providers.name: Briter
providers.description: Delivered the ecosystem mapping & analysis study (insights, interviews, and report) supporting AI4SU ecosystem understanding.

providers.name: Zindi
providers.description: Platform hosting online AI4SU hackathons; competition setup, participant management, leaderboard/scoring, and publication of open resources.

challengeProviders.sectionDescription: Startups that provided the datasets and problem statements behind the AI4SU hackathons and online challenges.

providers.name: FarmSAWA
providers.description: Kenyan AI-powered agronomic advisory platform (WhatsApp). Provided dataset/challenge for AI4SU in-person hackathon(s) focused on inclusive credit scoring / climate & market resilience.

providers.name: AgriBORA
providers.description: Kenyan agri-fintech/digital agriculture platform. Provided dataset/challenge for AI4SU online hackathon on weekly maize price forecasting.

providers.name: Farm to Feed
providers.description: Kenyan food supply chain / produce distribution startup. Provided dataset/challenge for AI4SU online hackathon on produce recommendation systems to reduce food waste.

providers.name: Afrimash
providers.description: Agri-ecommerce startup (Ghana). Provided customer/transaction data for AI4SU in-person hackathon challenge on segmentation, retention, and lifetime value intelligence.

providers.name: DigiCow
providers.description: Kenyan agritech app supporting farmers (training/extension & farm management). Provided dataset/challenge for AI4SU online hackathon on predicting practice adoption.

providers.name: Rhea
providers.description: Kenyan soil health management company. Provided dataset/challenge for AI4SU online hackathon on soil nutrient prediction.

providers.name: Tolbi
providers.description: Climate-Agtech using satellite imagery and AI for precision agriculture. Provided dataset/challenge for AI4SU online hackathon on crop classification (satellite).

datagovInitiative.title: Part of the DataGov Initiative
datagovInitiative.description: AI4Startups is part of the broader Data Governance in Africa initiative, supporting responsible data governance and AI development across the continent.
